title: Use the acquired model and retain its refresh bill
statement: On acceptance P_t=lambda I+N_Q obeys P_t<=A_t<=1.5P_t. Actual residual iteration x+=P_t^-1(b-A_t x) contracts A-error by at least 2^-k from zero for every b, even chosen after model acquisition; Woodbury/small elimination earns P^-1 rather than an inverse oracle. General changing K pays new KQ. Only the extra affine interface K_theta=sum theta_j B_j with PSD components, nonnegative parameters and actual component products permits mJ cached B_j q. A known parameter box supplies an accessible upper envelope; valid cached certificates persist as Q grows. Certificates for separate components do not certify every mixture.
